newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia extends 2nd Sydney airport study.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia extends 2nd Sydney airport study.

text.p: Australian Transport Minister John Sharp said on Wednesday the government had extended the deadline for its environmental impact study on a second airport for Sydney, the country's biggest city.
"The government has decided to extend the period for the EIS (environmental impact study) by at least a period of two months," he told parliament.
Sharp said more time was needed to assess the overwhelming number of submissions to the study.
"As a result of the commitment of this government to propoer community consultation, the EIS process will be extended by at least two months," he said.
The government has ordered an environmental impact study on two possible sites for a second airport, at Badgerys Creek in the city's west and Holsworthy in the south-west.
It had hoped to complete the report by the end of March.
Sydney, Australia's busiest air gateway, desperately needs a second airport to increase capacity.
